DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: こんな時間に連絡する理由なんて、ひとつしかないでしょ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 教えちゃったら来ないかもしれないし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気になるんだったら、こっちに来てよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: とんでもない物があるよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: もしかして、また暇なの……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 待ってて！すぐ助けに行くから！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お肉や果物は腐るギリギリが一番美味しいって聞いたんだけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それがね、この村でくさやを食べる機会があって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 臭いはひどかったんだけど、旨味が濃縮されてたから……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ほかの魚も、腐らせたらどうなるんだろうなって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 発酵処理と、ただ腐らせるのは――

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: たぶん別じゃないかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ひどい臭いのほうに興味があるだけなんだよね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それが、昨日からポータブル発電機の調子が悪くてさ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 調べてみたら、フィルターのところに塩の結晶が付いてたんだ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 潮風のせいで、内側も錆びちゃってて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今さら防食処理ってのもね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: かといって、野営地を移すのも難しいし

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: この近くに、みんなで泊まれる安い宿ってないのかな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そんな都合良く宿があるとは思えないけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それなら、助けられるかもしれない

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이런 시간에 연락을 한다면 이유야 뻔하지…

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 무슨 일인지 궁금하면 보내 준 주소로 찾아와.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 쉴 새 없이 마구 폭발하고 있어!

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 조금만 기다려! 금방 도와주러 갈 테니까!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 과일과 고기는 썩기 직전이 가장 맛있다고 하던데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 다른 게 아니라, 이 마을에서 쿠사야를 몇 번 먹어볼 기회가 있었는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 냄새는 썩은 것처럼 지독한데 감칠맛은 평범한 생선보다 더 진하더라고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서 다른 생선도 썩히면 괜찮아질까 싶어서

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 발효균 중에는 단백질을 분해하는 종이 많으니까—

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 엄밀히 말하자면 썩히는 것과는 다르지 않을까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내 관심사는 감칠맛이 아니라 지독한 냄새에 있으니 아무래도 상관없지만.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그게 어제부터 휴대용 발전기의 상태가 좋지 않아서 살펴봤는데

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 필터 주변에 소금 결정이 잔뜩 맺혀 있더라고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무래도 바닷바람을 너무 맞아서 안쪽에 녹이 슬었나 봐

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그러게 말이야. 지금 와서 부식 방지 처리를 할 수도 없고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 지금 당장 바닷바람이 들지 않는 장소로 야영지를 옮길 수도 없고

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이 근처에 소대원 모두가 묵을 수 있는 저렴한 숙소가 없으려나?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이런 벽지에 그렇게 형편 좋은 숙소가 있을 것 같지는 않지만……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 그런 문제라면 내가 도와줄 수 있을 것 같은데

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You busy?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I don't have any particular plans...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's wrong? Did something happen?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm messaging you late at night, isn't it obvious?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm heckin' bored!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Where are the rest of RABBIT squad members?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ah, the thing is

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Eh, it's no fun to just text it to you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you wanna know, come to the address I just sent you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll be waiting.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's something amazing here!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's going on, Moe?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: If you're just bored, like last time...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The explosions

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The explosions won't stop!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Relentless explosions!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's exploding?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Hold tight! I'm coming to save you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I heard fruit and meat are just the most delicious right before they go bad.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So you think it'd be the same with fish?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What makes you say that?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You see, I got the chance to try kusaya while I was here...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And the smell? PHEW. Nasty. Rotten. But it was the most savory thing I've ever tried.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Which made me wonder, do all fish taste good rotten?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: There are many species of fermenting bacteria that break down protein.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's technically a little different than leaving it to rot.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: ...You think so?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Anyway, I'm fascinated with the nasty smell, not the taste.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's the part you liked?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What a pain...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Everything okay?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The portable generator started being wonky yesterday, so I went to take a look.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: A bunch of salt crystals accumulated around the filter.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: All the sea breeze in the area must've made it rot.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That sounds bad.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It is. It's not like I can treat it with corrosion protection now,

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: and there's nowhere to move our camp site that'd be safe from the sea breeze.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Is there a cheap room that could accommodate all the squad members?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We're out in the sticks. Doubt it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Um...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I think I have a solution.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Huh? Really?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู~

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตอนนี้ยุ่งหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ก็ไม่ได้มีงานอะไรพิเศษนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมเหรอ? มีเรื่องอะไรหรือเปล่า?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันติดต่อครูมาเวลานี้ มันก็ต้องมีเรื่อง
แหงอยู่แล้ว...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันเบื่อน่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
สมาชิกกองทหาร RABBIT คนอื่นๆ
ไปไหนกันเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า เรื่องนั้นน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าเล่าให้ฟังก็หมดสนุกน่ะสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าอยากรู้ก็มาตามพิกัดที่ฉันส่งไปนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วฉันจะรอนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ตรงนี้มีอะไรที่สุดยอดเลยละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จู่ๆ มีเรื่องอะไรเหรอ โมเอะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หรือว่าแค่เบื่อเหมือนครั้งก่อนอีก...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ระเบิด

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: มันระเบิดไม่หยุดเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ระเบิดตู้มแบบไม่พักเลยละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ว่าไงนะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อะไรระเบิดน่ะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
รอครูแป๊บหนึ่งนะ! ครูจะไปช่วย
เดี๋ยวนี้ละ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เห็นว่าผลไม้กับเนื้อสัตว์จะอร่อยที่สุด
ตอนก่อนจะเสียนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นปลาก็น่าจะเหมือนกันมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ทำไมจู่ๆ ถึงคิดเรื่องนั้นล่ะ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พอดีว่าฉันได้ลองกินคูซายะที่เป็นปลา
หมักของหมู่บ้านนี้มา 2-3 ครั้งน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
กลิ่นมันฉุนเหมือนเสียแล้วยังไงไม่รู้
แต่มันให้รสกลมกล่อมมากกว่าปลา
ทั่วๆ ไปอีกนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันก็เลยคิดว่าปลาชนิดอื่นๆ ก็น่าจะ
อร่อยถ้ามันเน่าเสียน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
เชื้อหมักมีหลายตัวที่ย่อยสลาย
โปรตีนได้...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ในทางเทคนิคแล้ว มันก็ไม่น่าจะ
ต่างกับการเน่าเสียมั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ก็นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
สิ่งที่ฉันสนใจไม่ใช่รสชาติ แต่เป็นกลิ่น
แรงๆ นั่นมากกว่า งั้นก็ไม่มีปัญหาหรอก

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เป็นงั้นไป?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ยุ่งแล้วละ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: มีปัญหาอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
พอดีเครื่องกำเนิดไฟฟ้าแบบพกพา
มันมีปัญหาตั้งแต่เมื่อวาน ฉันก็เลยลอง
เช็กดูน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ปรากฏว่ามีผลึกเกลืออยู่รอบๆ ฟิลเตอร์
เยอะแยะเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
มันคงโดนลมทะเลมากจนขึ้นสนิม
ข้างในน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เป็นเรื่องใหญ่เลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็นั่นน่ะสิ จะมากันสนิมเอาป่านนี้ก็
ไม่ทันแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แล้วจะย้ายแคมป์ไปอยู่ในที่ที่ไม่โดน
ลมทะเลตอนนี้เลยก็ไม่ได้ด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แถวนี้พอจะมีที่พักถูกๆ ที่สมาชิก
กองทหารทุกคนจะไปพักได้อยู่บ้างมั้ยนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ที่ทุรกันดารแบบนี้ก็ไม่น่าจะมีที่พักดีๆ
ด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อืม... ครูก็พอช่วยได้นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าเป็นเรื่องนั้นครูน่าจะช่วยได้อยู่นะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม? ยังไงเหรอ?

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 現在很忙嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 目前是沒什麼事要做啦……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼了？有什麼事嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 之所以在這種時候聯絡……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 當然是因為無聊囉！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 其他RABBIT小隊的成員呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，你說他們啊

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 直接告訴你就不好玩了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果好奇他們在做什麼的話，就到這個地點來吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我會在這裡等你

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我這邊有個很厲害的東西喔！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼有點沒頭沒尾的呢，萌？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 如果跟上次一樣只是覺得無聊的話……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 爆炸

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 爆炸聲

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 爆炸聲正在不停地傳來！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 什麼！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 是什麼爆炸了！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 你等著！我立刻過去幫你！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 聽說水果和肉類，在快要腐爛的時候是最好吃的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 魚類會不會也一樣呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 為什麼突然思考這種問題……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 其實也沒什麼，只是因為在這個村子裡吃到過幾次臭魚乾

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然那東西聞起來像腐爛了一樣，味道卻比一般的魚還好吃

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 所以我才在想，其他的魚是不是也可以放到壞掉再吃

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 畢竟是利用了某些能分解蛋白質的酵母菌──

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 所以嚴格來說，那其實跟單純的腐壞不太一樣吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……是嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 反正我有興趣的是那種濃烈的臭味，而不是食物本身，所以應該差不多吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 你有興趣的竟然是臭味！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 真傷腦筋……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 怎麼了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 因為我的攜帶式發電機從昨天開始就怪怪的，所以就檢查了一下

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒想到發電機的過濾器周圍竟然結滿了鹽巴結晶

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我猜可能是海風吹太久的關係，導致發電機內部生鏽了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那還真糟糕

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 就是說啊。現在既沒辦法幫發電機做防鏽處理

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 也不可能馬上把營地遷到沒有海風的地方

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這附近會有便宜的旅社，能讓我們小隊暫時住一陣子嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然我覺得這麼偏僻的地方，應該不太可能會有好的旅社就是了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 唔嗯……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 如果是這樣的話，說不定我能幫上忙

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 咦？真的嗎？
